Title: AI Memory Suite Implementation Plan
Content: A full six-seat, ten-round council review produced a phased implementation plan for turning MemorySmith into a governed AI memory suite. The plan recommends a custom per-wiki tag policy with allowlists, blocklists, aliases, lexical-analysis suggestions, and UI tag management; warning-first staleness and supersession diagnostics; a Phase 0 audit of automatic maintenance deprecation behavior; structured JSON tool envelopes; source-backed Agent write proposals; and evidence-gated schema/page retrieval upgrades. The plan is documentation only and does not implement code. It makes current maintenance status mutation a first gate because triage and consolidation can move records to Deprecated by score before the warning-first model exists.
